fullContentHtml:
MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari PET Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released PET Admit Card for the posts of Forest Guard and Jail Prahari. This recruitment was released for 1679 posts. Applications for the MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 28 February 2026, to 30 April 2026. The written examination was held on 04 June 2026. Candidates who appeared in this examination this form can download their MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari PET Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 February 2026
  • Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Correction Date : 30 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 04 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 June 2026
  • Result : 14 August 2026
  • PET Exam Date : 07 to 18 October 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 06 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 60/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
